summary: Preserve managed GitHub description ownership and verify outbound body projection

delivery.outcome: Managed GitHub descriptions round-trip without nesting or importing remote-only discussion; explicit empty descriptions clear the owned region, ambiguous markers fail before mutation, and fresh/reused outbound receipts verify the managed description without weakening identity, lifecycle, snapshot or live-execution guards.
nonGoals: No mass rewrite of historical issue bodies
No schema, dependency or public signature changes

architecture.decision: Keep ownership parsing/projection in GitHubBackend, verify opt-in managed descriptions in existing outbound readbacks and receipt reuse, and fail closed for missing mapped issues instead of allocating replacements. Preserve unmarked legacy imports, all unowned prose, and existing339snapshot/live execution safeguards.
architecture.rollback: Revert bounded code through independent publication; keep provider/local data and all existing receipts.

validation.evidence: Pending admitted native projection, stable roundtrip, empty, ambiguity, receipt reuse, identity/legacy/live-execution regressions.
Pending native gate, all8protectedchecks and independent exact-head merge.
